//: Root tsconfig — exists for the Vercel function build only.
`api/index.ts` sits outside every workspace, so Vercel's Node builder has
no package tsconfig to inherit and falls back to defaults. The default
includes full .d.ts checking, and `googleapis` ships type definitions
large enough to exhaust the build container's heap — the function build
dies with 'Reached heap limit' while the app itself is perfectly fine.
`skipLibCheck` is the fix. The workspaces keep their own tsconfigs and are
unaffected; each is built with an explicit -p.
